#languages #pronunciation

Not trying to sound "neutral", just to stop clients asking me to repeat myself on calls. My Manchester vowels are
fine, the problem is mumbling and dropping word endings when I'm nervous. Six sessions with speech coach Harriet
Lowe (£45 each, Zoom, January to March 2024): she had me read the "Comma Gets a Cure" passage every session and
count the dropped final consonants, 19 in the first recording, 6 in the last. Habits that stuck: slow down 10%,
pause at commas, open the jaw on stressed vowels. Same copy-the-native approach as [[Shadowing technique]], applied
to English. Big test is the talk I pitched in [[Conference talk proposal]].
